id.description: An identifier for this procedure, e.g. decay-2026-10-14-01.

standard.description: The standard the method follows, if any.

purpose.description: What the test is for, in one line.

volume.description: ISA-95 path of the volume under test, e.g. /habitat/lab.

device.description: ISA-95 path of the device the steps command.

quantity.description: a quantity of the unit system (physics.units_normalize says which quantity takes a unit)

quantities.description: What the test measures: each a quantity of the unit system with one of its units. For a device's property, the quantity and the unit its register declares (factory.inventory, measures); a word of the property's name is not its quantity. physics.units_normalize with the unit alone says which quantity takes a unit.

hypotheses.description: What the test does not measure and leaves to be decided otherwise.

limits.description: The bounds the test stays within.

occupancy.description: Who is in the volume, as read.

monitoring.description: People monitored during the test, if any.

n.description: The step's number. A path names a step by it, never by its position in the list: steps.1.speedPercent is the speed of the step whose n is 1.

id.description: What the executor reads to stop the test (see the description of abort). A path names a condition by it, never by its position in the list: abort.co2.threshold is the threshold of the condition whose id is co2.

threshold.description: A number (the battery's percent); leave the field out for a condition that has none, never null

abort.description: The conditions that stop the test, by the id of what the executor can read. A condition that cannot be read stops the test.

expected.description: What the test is expected to show, written before it runs.
